derived_from: Official AdaFace pretrained weights, exported to ONNX and hosted in the yakhyo/uniface-weights repository.

paper.title: AdaFace: Quality Adaptive Margin for Face Recognition

input: float32 NCHW [batch, 3, 112, 112]; the graph has no input Sub/Mul node, so normalisation is applied outside the model (validated preprocessing: RGB, (x - 127.5) / 127.5).
output: 512-d unit-length vector; the graph ends in ReduceL2 + Div, so the raw output already has L2 norm 1.
